summary.title: uv
summary.one_liner: uv is a fast Rust-based Python package and project manager that can replace pip, pipx, poetry, pyenv, and virtualenv in one tool.
keywords: how to replace pip with something faster
takeaways: uv covers many Python tasks (packages, projects, scripts, tools, Python versions) in a single binary written in Rust.
uv init, uv add, uv lock, and uv sync manage project dependencies and environments with a universal lockfile.
uv run can execute single-file scripts with inline dependency metadata in an isolated environment.
uvx (uv tool run) runs command-line tools from Python packages without a permanent install; uv tool install installs them.
The uv pip interface is a drop-in pip-compatible option that the page says gives a 10-100x speedup.
summary.summary:
This is the official documentation landing page for uv, an extremely fast Python package and project manager written in Rust, backed by Astral. It gives a feature overview and short command-line examples for projects (init, add, lock, sync, run), single-file scripts with inline metadata, running and installing tools (uvx, uv tool install), installing Python versions, and a pip-compatible interface (uv pip compile, venv, sync). The page links to fuller guides for first steps, projects, scripts, tools, Python versions, and the pip interface, and states it supports macOS, Linux, and Windows.</summary>
